comparisons.name: page-light
comparisons.description: The field of the key Safari window with a page loaded, Aqua: Reader button, padlock and host, Reload. Whole crop, with the host in the fallback font.

comparisons.name: page-light-bezel
comparisons.description: As page-light with the host masked (it is set in the fallback font off Apple platforms), to score the bezel, the padlock and the two glyphs.

comparisons.name: page-dark
comparisons.description: The field of the key Safari window with a page loaded, Dark Aqua. Whole crop.

comparisons.name: page-dark-bezel
comparisons.description: As page-dark with the host masked.

comparisons.name: placeholder-light
comparisons.description: The empty field of the Favorites window, Aqua: magnifier and placeholder, centred. Whole crop.

comparisons.name: placeholder-light-bezel
comparisons.description: As placeholder-light with the placeholder text masked, to score the bezel and the magnifier.

comparisons.name: focused-dark
comparisons.description: The empty field of the dark Favorites window while it is edited, focused with a real click: focus ring, magnifier and placeholder at the leading edge. Whole crop.

comparisons.name: focused-dark-bezel
comparisons.description: As focused-dark with the placeholder text masked, to score the focus ring, the bezel and the magnifier.

comparisons.name: reader-light
comparisons.description: The field of the Safari window in Reader mode, Aqua: the Reader button on, padlock and host, the text options. Whole crop.

comparisons.name: reader-light-bezel
comparisons.description: As reader-light with the host masked, to score the bezel, the filled Reader button, the padlock and the text-options glyph.

comparisons.name: inactive-light
comparisons.description: The field of the inactive Safari window behind the Picture in Picture video, Aqua: flat outlined bezel, padlock and host, the audio button and Reload. Whole crop.

comparisons.name: inactive-light-bezel
comparisons.description: As inactive-light with the host masked.

comparisons.name: inactive-dark
comparisons.description: The field of the inactive Safari window behind the Picture in Picture video, Dark Aqua. Whole crop.

comparisons.name: inactive-dark-bezel
comparisons.description: As inactive-dark with the host masked.

comparisons.name: focus-ring-light
comparisons.description: The field while it is edited in the key window, focused with a real click, Aqua: the 3 pt focus ring outside the fill. No capture shows the ring in Aqua.

pixels.note: ring over the page background, measured on the Go to Folder field (spec: focus-ring, sRGB); that this field takes it in Aqua is inferred from the dark capture
page just outside the ring: it ends 3 pt beyond the fill, as measured in the dark Favorites capture

comparisons.name: focus-ring-dark
comparisons.description: The field while it is edited in the key window, Dark Aqua, on the page background.

pixels.note: ring over a dark window (spec: focus-ring, sRGB); the same ring is compared with the dark Favorites capture in focused-dark
page just outside the ring

comparisons.name: focus-inactive-light
comparisons.description: The field focused with a real click in an inactive window, Aqua: it is edited, but draws no focus ring.

pixels.note: page where the ring would be: a control shows its focus ring only in the key window (CONTRIBUTING, Window state)
the Reader button stays filled: middle of the measured #676767 to #636363

comparisons.name: focus-main-dark
comparisons.description: The field focused with a real click in a main window, Dark Aqua: no focus ring.

pixels.note: page where the ring would be: no focus ring in a window that is not key

comparisons.name: reader-on-light
comparisons.description: The Reader button's on fill and an accessory glyph at rest, Aqua.

pixels.note: on fill at mid height, measured in Light-Safari-v13-Reader-Mode @ 930,114
Reload arrowhead: black at 50.6% over the fill, measured as #7a7a79 in Light-Safari-v13
the disabled field's Reload arrowhead: the disabled control text colour, black at 25%, over the fill; inferred, no capture shows a disabled field

comparisons.name: reader-on-dark
comparisons.description: The Reader button's on fill, which the dark Reader-Mode capture shows, and an accessory glyph at rest and disabled, Dark Aqua.

pixels.note: on fill, measured in Dark-Safari-v13-Reader-Mode @ 880,114
Reload arrowhead: white at 85% over the fill on the #323232 page; measured as #e9e9ea on the Safari toolbar
the disabled field's Reload arrowhead: white at 25% over the fill (white at 25.3% over #323232); inferred

comparisons.name: pressed-accessory-light
comparisons.description: The Reload button while the mouse is held down on it, Aqua: its glyph takes the text colour.

pixels.note: black at 69% over the fill, the measured text colour #4c4c4c; that a pressed glyph takes it is inferred

comparisons.name: pressed-accessory-dark
comparisons.description: The Reload button while the mouse is held down on it, Dark Aqua.

pixels.note: the measured text colour; that a pressed glyph takes it is inferred

comparisons.name: return-in-form
comparisons.description: Return in a field inside a form, pressed in a real browser: the field's onSubmit runs and the form around it is not submitted. The capture is the modal dialog the fixture opens.

pixels.note: first square: system green, the field's onSubmit ran (red, #ff3b30, when it did not)
second square: system green, the form was not submitted (red when it was)

comparisons.name: escape-in-dialog
comparisons.description: Escape in a field inside a native modal dialog, pressed in a real browser after typing: the dialog stays open (the capture is the dialog, so a dismissed one fails) and nothing is submitted.

pixels.note: first square: system red, the field's onSubmit did not run
second square: system green, the form was not submitted
the dialog's own fill, the window background token: it is still open
